Original Article
CARDIOLOGY
Early mobilization after cardiac surgery and
length of hospital stay: a randomized trial
Ana Souza,1 Rui Lima,2 and Clara Neves1
1Department of Cardiology, Hospital Example, Porto Alegre, Brazil; 2School of Medicine, Example University

Patients who leave bed within 24 hours of cardiac surgery may recover faster. We randomized 412 adults
to early or usual mobilization and compared the length of their hospital stay.

12 JUNE 2026 | VOLUME 41, NUMBER 6
Downloaded from journal.example.org/article-pdf/41/6/301 by guest on 29 September 2026

Methods
Adults undergoing elective surgery were eligible. The primary outcome was the length of stay.

Results
Early mobilization shortened the stay by 1.2 days on average.
